I couldn't confirm gluten-free status for any CVS Health multivitamin on cvs.com. The search results have no gluten-free filter. The two product pages I read, which are the two top-reviewed candidates, don't say "gluten free" anywhere in their details, ingredients or specifications.

The CVS Health multivitamins under $15 with the most reviews are below. Prices and review counts come from the search results.

The first two are tied for most reviewed. The Men 50+ Advanced is cheaper and has the higher rating. Its ingredient list names only vitamins and minerals, with no gluten-containing ingredients, but the page makes no gluten-free claim. The Women's 120 CT lists inactive ingredients such as starch and maltodextrin, also with no gluten-free claim.

I didn't open the other three products, and I didn't check search pages 2–3 for other candidates. I also didn't see any CVS Health multivitamin over $15 that would have changed the ranking.

If gluten-free matters for allergy or celiac reasons, check the physical label or contact CVS before buying.
